Submit the application through proper channel, requesting the parent organisation to forward it with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance and APAR ratings for the preceding 04 years.

content_sections.heading: UPMRC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. UPMRC/HR/D/5/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UPMRC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a Govt recognized University/Institute with 60% marks; Service: Personnel Officers (IRPS) of Indian Railways / Personnel or HR Officers of Metros / Central Govt Officer having experience of HR during deputation to DoPT; CDA: working or empanelled in SAG pay scale Rs 1,44,200-2,18,200/- (Level-14) or higher with 17 years post-qualification experience at Group-A Gazetted / Executive Level; OR Selection Grade Rs. 1,23,100-2,15,900/- (Level-13) or higher for at least 03 years with 17 years such experience; IDA: working or empanelled in IDA pay scale Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 or higher with 17 years such experience; OR IDA pay scale Rs. 90,000-2,40,000/- or higher for at least 03 years with 17 years such experience Experience: Deep knowledge and post qualification work experience in Manpower Planning / Recruitment & Selection / Training, Grievance Management, RTI, Legal cases pertaining to employment/service matters & other disciplinary aspects, Conduct, Discipline & Appeal Rules, Promotion policies, DPC & Career Progression schemes, Working knowledge on SAP/ERP and E-Office. Age limit: Maximum 57 years (as on last date of vacancy notification) Other conditions: Applications invited from officers of Indian Nationality from Indian Railways / Metros / Central Govt having relevant HR experience Experience should be with Indian Railways / Metros / Central Govt Officer having experience of HR during deputation to DoPT Candidate should be free from DAR/Vigilance Applicant should be fit in related field and physically and medically fit

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Parent pay plus deputation allowance on deputation basis. Deputation: normal tenure of 3 years, which may be extendable May be posted at any project site/office at any location of UPMRC projects during tenure Appointees deemed public servants for UPMRC's Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules, 2017

content_sections.heading: How Will UPMRC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting (UPMRC reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview) Interview in Lucknow Eligible candidates called for interview in Lucknow; selection based on interview UPMRC reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational Certificates (including Matric Certificate for age eligibility) Work Experience Certificate NOC from present Employer APARs of the last 04 years Certificate by the Employer verifying details, with signature and stamp

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UPMRC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application proforma enclosed with the notice. Submit the application through proper channel, requesting the parent organisation to forward it with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance and APAR ratings for the preceding 04 years. Send the application in writing to Manager/HR, UPMRC, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomtinagar, Lucknow-226010 before 16-12-2026. An advance copy with all supporting documents may be emailed to [email protected] ; hard copy is mandatory. Submission of NOC before interview is a must for participating in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Advance copy with supporting documents may be sent to [email protected] ; hard copy is mandatory Applications after closing date and incomplete applications will not be entertained No travelling allowance for attending the interview Final result will be informed through UPMRC website Applications through proper channel with verified service particulars, SPE/D&AR/Vigilance clearance and APARs will be preferred Management reserves the right to cancel/postpone the entire process

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UPMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UPMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for General Manager (HR).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UPMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application proforma enclosed with the notice (pages 4-7)) and send it to Manager/HR, Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomtinagar, Lucknow-226010, by in writing through proper channel (hard copy mandatory); advance copy may be emailed, to reach by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a Govt recognized University/Institute with 60% marks; Group-A Gazetted/Executive level officers in specified CDA/IDA pay scales with 17 years of post-qualification work experience and HR experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications invited from officers of Indian Nationality from Indian Railways / Metros / Central Govt having relevant HR experience. Applicant should be fit in related field and physically and medically fit.

faq.answer: Shortlisting (UPMRC reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview). Interview in Lucknow. Eligible candidates called for interview in Lucknow; selection based on interview. UPMRC reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview.

faq.answer: Deputation: normal tenure of 3 years, which may be extendable. May be posted at any project site/office at any location of UPMRC projects during tenure. Appointees deemed public servants for UPMRC's Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules, 2017.
